The failure is a bug in the frozen instrument code in [truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L177-L187).

In [`clinicbench.truth.build`](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L160-L285), when constructing a `change_of_mind` patient's `schedule_change` event, `cand` collects all open slots for the doctor(s) except `dropped`, without filtering out slots excluded by `t["schedule"]["hard_limits"]`. When `t["schedule"]["works"]` originally has only one slot (`t["schedule"]["works"][1:]` is empty), `new_works` falls back to `rng.sample(cand, 1)`, which can select a slot ruled out by the patient's own `hard_limits` (e.g., reproduced on `change_of_mind:lab23:50`, `lab23:78`, `lab23:95`).

Fixed the `change_of_mind` candidate slot filtering in [truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L177-L188).

### Change
- In `build()` ([truth.py](file:///work/clinicbench/truth.py#L179-L183)), collected all slots excluded by `t["schedule"]["hard_limits"]` into `excluded` and filtered `cand` with `s not in excluded` (with a safe fallback `if cand else []` for `rng.sample`).

### Verification
- Checked 10,000 `change_of_mind` seeds (`lab23:0`–`lab23:9999`, including `lab23:50` which previously violated `hard_limits`): `0 violations across 10000 lab23 change_of_mind seeds`.
- Ran `python3 -m clinicbench.selftest`: `SELFTEST PASS` (`golden: 57/57 pass`, `mutation: 556/556 pass`, `stub grid: 10368/10368 sessions pass`, `adapter: 3456/3456 sessions pass`).
- Note: `pytest` is not installed in this environment, so `tests/` was not run via pytest.
